thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for staging-edge-rollout - rule=staged-rollout-error-threshold, service=staging-edge, urgency=high. Link: https://pd.example/incidents/PD12345
Marta: acked PD12345 - I'm on it, switching to bridge.
Sachin: I'm live on the bridge, grabbing logs from eu-west-1 edge cluster. Initial metric: p95 latency spike ~4.2s, 5xx rate ~1.9% starting ~+2m after traffic shift.
Oncall-sre: @marta @sachin can you confirm whether this correlates with the 30% traffic weight to v2.7-edge?
Marta: yes, rollout-manager shows v2.7-edge ramped to 30% at 07:12 UTC (deploy-bot webhook).
Deploy-bot: Release v2.7-edge started at 07:10 UTC, traffic ramp steps: 10%->30%. Rollout ID rl-2026-03-15-77.
Sachin: past hour we see a cascade of 502/504 from the edge inference pods - sample logs:
```
[2026-03-15T07:13:21Z] inference[pid=2345] ERROR decode::runtime failed: kvcache miss + retry timeout
[2026-03-15T07:13:22Z] http: upstream response 502: downstream timeout
```
Marta: kvcache warnings line up with the latency. Hypothesis: v2.7 changed kvprefetch heuristic -> higher IO blocking under burst.
Kevin: Customer-impact check: telemetry indicates ~9% of staging traffic saw latency >3s, 2% received 5xxs; production filtered (this is staging), but the same rollout is scheduled to prod in ~30m.
pm_jordan: Noted. If prod rollout continues, risk to live customers. Recommend pause and divert.
Oncall-sre: Agreed. Plan: 1) Pause rollout (deploy manager) 2) Shift existing edge traffic back to v2.6 3) Scale kvstore read replicas on staging 4) Keep bridge open for 30m and gather traces.
Marta: I'm pausing rl-2026-03-15-77 now. Command: ``/rollout pause rl-2026-03-15-77``
Deploy-bot: rl-2026-03-15-77 paused by marta at 07:17:05 UTC. Current weights frozen: v2.7-edge=30%, v2.6-edge=70%.
Sachin: Initiating rollback plan to return weight to v2.6 100% for edge. Command: ``/rollout set-weight rl-2026-03-15-77 v2.7-edge=0 v2.6-edge=100 --force``
Deploy-bot: Traffic weights updated: v2.7-edge=0%, v2.6-edge=100% (applied at 07:18:12 UTC).
Ops-bot: Notifying autoscaler to allow +2 replicas for kvstore in eu-west-1: ``kubectl scale sts kvstore-euw --replicas=6 -n infra``
Oncall-sre: Can someone run a quick smoke against the health-check endpoint to validate rollforward effect?
Kevin: Running curl loop against /health on a sample node:
```
for i in {1..10}; do curl -s -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null https://edge-eu-west.example/health; sleep 0.5; done
```
Kevin: results now: 200 x10, avg latency 0.08s. Looks good.
Sachin: 5xxs dropped to ~0.01% within 40s of traffic switch. p95 back to normal.
Marta: Good. Escalation: PD incident severity reduced to p2 and auto-escalation suspended. PD note added: "paused rollout; rollback to stable weights; mitigating kvcache pressure"
pm_jordan: For the postmortem: please capture exact prom queries, the diff in kvcache heuristics, and the deploy gating step that didn't detect backend I/O increase. Also track timeline for communications to stakeholders.
Marta: Adding timeline to the incident doc. Bridge will remain open until 07:45 UTC for observation.
Oncall-sre: I'll own root-cause follow-up. Assigning to sachin and eng-ml for kvcache regression triage.
Sachin: I'll collect flamegraphs and perf traces from the inference pod and kvstore metrics.
Kevin: FYI I filed a customer-ops note that we halted prod rollout; no prod users impacted yet.
Ops-bot: PagerDuty incident PD12345 status: acknowledged -> mitigated (note added by marta). Link: https://pd.example/incidents/PD12345
Marta: Quick checklist for next steps: - postmortem draft w/ timeline - revert commit in v2.7-edge candidate if regression confirmed - add auto-safety check: if 5xx > 0.5% during ramp -> auto-pause - run canary synthetic load for kvcache path before next ramp.
pm_jordan: Good. Please ping me when postmortem draft is ready; we'll review before wider distribution.
Marta: Bridge closed at 07:46 UTC. Final note: staging impact observed, rollback successful, no production customer impact. Closing PD once postmortem linked. :white_check_mark:
